coaching.headline: We won five fights but cashed only one, conceded Orb Prime uncontested, and lost towers 2-9.
coaching.team: Four of five lanes read favored, with the duo lane winning first blood and the first Fangtooth, but that early edge never became a lead. We won five fights and converted one; they won seven and converted four. Orb Prime fell at 32 with all five of us alive and uncontested. Towers finished 2-9, river control 8-22.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The fight at 28.5, lost 0-4 at the Inner Tower, cost three inner towers and all three inhibitors within the next minute — the single collapse that opened the base.
coaching.whatWorked: Serath dominated the jungle matchup: 16 kills and the team's highest hero damage and objective damage all game.

26.4.call: Lost the fight 2-4 but took their outer tower while they claimed Primal Fangtooth elsewhere — a trade, not a clean loss.

28.5.call: Four dead for nothing triggered the base collapse a minute later — the right call was disengaging, not trading bodies.

29.9.call: Won this fight 3-0, but Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth both fell to them in the same window — a losing trade.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Serath finished the full meta core (Sky Splitter, Storm Breaker, Spectra) but skipped armor for Tainted Rounds and Orion against a 4-physical draft; Drongo and Adele combined for 7 of her 9 deaths, though the match doesn't prove the missing armor caused those deaths.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Maco skipped the whole meta core (Crescelia, Enra's Blessing, Windcaller) for sustain items instead; the match cannot prove it mattered since he barely reached a fight after minute 12.

945d2212-7bba-4dcf-a015-5df1c7977eca.build: Kwang built away from the meta core (Spirit Of Amir, Oathkeeper, Tainted Scepter) toward tankier items; no single fight in the data proves the swap cost or won anything.

cf3f9ecf-4d7e-46f8-8703-6986d2b40803.build: Sparrow skipped Storm Breaker and Spectra for Equinox; against Narbash's 55,104 healing and Adele's 14,121, Tainted Rounds was the anti-heal call instead — the team ran only one anti-heal item all game.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Renna completed the full meta core (Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Overseer); the extra Amulet Of Chaos wasn't tested by a specific fight — on core, nothing to teach here.

focus.title: Convert the won offlane lane into fights
focus.evidence: Maco's offlane read favored all game, yet macro notes flag him alive and ahead in lane in six separate fights after minute 20 while the team fought short a body, and he finished zero damage to objectives.
focus.action: Once the offlane wave is shoved, rotate to the river or tower fight instead of resetting back to lane — the extra body flips several of these close losses.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.change: Cut the solo catches near objectives.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.receipt: Caught alone by Drongo at 25.5, directly preceding Primal Fangtooth falling at 26.7.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.change: Shove the won lane and rotate to river or tower fights.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.receipt: First blood on Adele at 4.1, then flagged alive and ahead in lane in six fights the team fought short a body (e.g. 20.5, 26.4, 28.5).

945d2212-7bba-4dcf-a015-5df1c7977eca.change: Avoid dying first into a fight.
945d2212-7bba-4dcf-a015-5df1c7977eca.receipt: 21 wards placed (team-high) vs. the enemy support's 19; died first in 2 of the game's fights.

cf3f9ecf-4d7e-46f8-8703-6986d2b40803.change: Carry anti-heal versus a two-healer comp.
cf3f9ecf-4d7e-46f8-8703-6986d2b40803.receipt: 13,720 damage to objectives, second-highest on the team; antiHealRec flags swapping Equinox for Tainted Rounds.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.change: Avoid the lone look into river before a group is ready.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.receipt: Caught alone by Yin at 15.7, one of three squad caught-out deaths this game.

threats: Heal-stacking: Adele, Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
ourKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
ourKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura
